emily: Ping  I dropped a draft changelog block for the upcoming docs release. Need quick checks: snippet parity (Py/JS), one-line Dedicated note, and any known-issue callouts. PTAL :eyes:
nate: Link?
emily: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/changelog/draft-3489  main calls: embeddings API surface changed; runtime now exposes `embeddings.create_v2` and JS uses camelCase `createV2`. Also we hit an edge-case with quantized models and long-context scoring.
paul: I'll update the Python snippet. For whatsnew keep it minimal. Example: `resp = client.embeddings.create_v2(model="rwd-embed-1", input=["hi"])`
anne: I'll do JS: `const resp = await client.embeddings.createV2({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: ['hi'] })` Keep casing guidance in migration guide.
emily: Add a Known issues line: "Quantized models on older GPUs may show slight logit variance for sequences >2048 tokens; re-run critical evals on full precision." Link to bug RED-2146.
paul: Also add a short troubleshooting tip: run a small sample with full-precision and compare top-k stability. One sentence under Known issues.
ci-bot: CI for PR #8421: linkcheck failed (rollout-policy anchor), lint passed. https://ci.internal/builds/8421
emily: Ugh the rollout-policy anchor again. Nate can you sweep anchors in routing docs?
nate: On it. I'll run the local linkcheck and fix the anchor.
anne: After snippets and anchor fix, can we preview staging and confirm snippet render and anchors?
emily: Yes; target to merge Wed EOD if staging OK; schedule publish Thu morning.
paul: Pushed snippet and Known issues edits.
nate: Anchor fix pushed. Ran linkcheck locally: clean. Pushed commit 8b9d.
ci-bot: Updated CI: linkcheck passed, staging build queued.
emily: Great. Anne, can you double-check JS casing in whatsnew inline (camelCase) and add a one-line Dedicated platform note (enterprise CTA) under Platform changes?
anne: Done. Minor copy tweak for clarity. Pushing now.
emily: Thanks all. If staging passes we'll ship on Thursday 09:00 PT. :tada:
